_regression.source: real map: Sawada (scripted hamlet) as shipped before waterfields.close_seams replaced the wedge filler (2026-08-17). `_fill_wedges` sampled the fan's bare ground on a 12 px grid, boxed each cluster of samples, and shrank the box toward its own centroid until it lapped its neighbours only shallowly - so every filler stopped a few px short of the bunds that already bounded its pocket and shipped as a free-standing rectangle with a ribbon of bare floor around it, and a filler whose edge landed a plot-width inside a neighbour drew a bund ring in the middle of that basin. GM: 'a tiny little standalone rectangle of earthen walls is just smack dab in the middle of where the field should be ... it should basically always be the case that two adjacent rice paddies share a single earthen wall rather than two different earthen walls.' The fix computes the bare ground exactly, PLANTS every pocket wide enough to hold a basin (so its outline IS the surrounding bunds) and ABSORBS every pocket too thin to plant into the basin it shares the most bund with.
